wall_name: Glass display cabinet with illuminated manuscripts
notes: Static single-camera talking-head shot of Umberto Eco seated in an orange leather armchair in front of a glass-fronted display cabinet holding open illuminated manuscript volumes (facsimiles), with further bookshelves visible blurred beyond the cabinet. Room identified as 'rare' (rare/illuminated-book display case, not an ordinary working shelf) rather than 'study' or 'living'. Shallow depth of field keeps Eco in sharp focus while the cabinet contents and background shelves stay soft bokeh at every timestamp in this clip -- no spine or manuscript text is legible at any zoom, confirmed by cropped/upscaled tile inspection. The two facing manuscript pages on the visible shelf are counted as unlabelled objects.
